title: Akseli and Elina
writer: Juho Gartz, Georg Korkman, Edvin Laine
actors: Aarno Sulkanen, Ulla Eklund, Risto Taulo
plot: A former Red Rebellion leader returns home after being imprisoned for his participation in the Finnish Civil War, but soon finds out that wartime mindsets still linger in the heads of people.
